note: Analyst reading of the news, written from logged events. Not data. The weekly agent replaces it every week. The log is a sample of named events; routine PLA flights and many coast-guard patrols are not logged. This tab was not updated between Jul 23 and Nov 2, 2026; the main items from that gap were added on Nov 2.
headline: Xi made a state visit to Washington on Sep 23-25 and held talks with Trump on Sep 24; Taiwan was discussed and no agreement was reported. Trump says he will meet Xi again in November in China (date not confirmed) and in December at the G20 (#3066).

A record $14 billion Taiwan arms package has been paused since May, and the US ambassador says Trump and Xi still discuss future Taiwan arms sales (#3064). No new sale is logged since Dec 18, 2025 (#3056).

The US and Japan held the Keen Sword 27 exercise on Oct 19-29, with US anti-ship missiles on Yonaguni near Taiwan (#3067), and USS Charleston operated near Sabina Shoal on Oct 20 (#3068). China protested and tracked the ship; no Chinese drill tied to either move was found.
Chinese coast guard ships faced Taiwanese ships near the Pratas Islands on Oct 20 and Nov 1, and China vowed to step up patrols east of Taiwan (#3069, #3070). Nothing links them to a US move.
Small numbers: most options have only a handful of counted cases.
